stem.en: A human body cell has 23 pairs of chromosomes. How many chromosomes does a human gamete carry?

text.en: 46, one complete copy of every pair

feedback.en: A gamete does not keep both chromosomes of a pair. Its number is halved.

text.en: 12, as only some pairs ever separate

feedback.en: Every pair separates, so all 23 pairs give one chromosome each.

text.en: 23, one from each of the 23 pairs

feedback.en: Yes. One chromosome from each pair makes 23.

text.en: 92, as all the chromosomes are copied

feedback.en: The copies are shared out in the two divisions. A gamete keeps 23.

explanation.en: In meiosis the chromosomes of each pair separate, so a gamete receives one chromosome from each of the 23 pairs: 23 in all.

hints.en: How many chromosomes does a gamete get from one pair?
